items.summary: Security disposition: evidence_needed for fleet-wide clearance; blocked for public exposure, go-live, and security-sensitive releases; conditional for ordinary reversible growth. Evidence: fleet-doctor has no run or results; operations deploy, uptime, and error sweeps are unavailable; authentication and access boundaries, secrets exposure, container isolation, release controls, dependency provenance, data exposure, monitoring, incident readiness, and security.txt/disclosure readiness are unverified. TLS evidence only shows no certificates expiring within 30 days and does not establish complete TLS posture. Compliance is a technical baseline, not certification: 37 pass, 16 fail, and 6 unknown. Exact decision: preserve private launch gates and continue only existing read-only evidence work. Permit ordinary reversible growth only when isolated, credential-free, permission-free, dependency-free, data-collection-free, disclosure-preserving, tested, measurable, and reversible. Do not deploy, access credentials or private containers, modify permissions/configuration, add dependencies, exploit targets, requeue failures, or conduct outreach.
